risks: The evaluation adds no contact with texters. Risks are re-identification from timestamps, and pressure on volunteers if fidelity data are used to judge individuals; data are aggregated by week and never reported by responder.
consent: A waiver of consent for de-identified conversation records, granted by the ethics board on condition of the data-sharing agreement; volunteers give verbal consent for the acceptability scale and may skip it.
data: The vendor exports timestamps, queue and flag fields without message text; the agency holds the only key to shift rosters; the analysis file is kept on the hospital research server with access limited to two analysts.
equity: PROGRESS-Plus: texters who are young, rural, LGBTQ+ or writing in a language other than English may be served differently; the keyword list is English only, so flag rates and waits are reported by conversation language and time of day, and the agency is asked to review the list with community partners.
effectiveness: Success is a sustained fall in evening waits and abandonment with the flag and surge roster delivered as designed; a failure of delivery points to a fix rather than abandoning the protocol.
efficiency: Uses data the platform already records; staff time only.
costs: Analyst and clinical lead time within existing roles; any vendor fee for the export is not yet known.
grants: None needed for the evaluation; results could support a regional mental health services grant for sustaining the surge roster.
partnerships: The agency's data lead and volunteer coordinator, two volunteer responders, a youth advisory group member with lived knowledge of crisis services, and the vendor for the export only.
rebPath: Approved by the hospital research ethics board on 2026-09-09 (REB-PSY-2026-071), conditional on a signed data-sharing agreement; no analysis begins before the agreement is signed.
limitations: No concurrent comparison; the keyword flag's accuracy is not measured against clinical judgement; message content is not examined.
summary: No texter contact, a consent waiver conditional on the data agreement, and equity reporting by language and time of day.
